snippet.title: How Grey’s Anatomy Shoots Those Intense Medical Scenes
snippet.description:
Though Grey’s Anatomy is pretty “hands-on” with its props, you’d be surprised to learn just how much of the show relies on CGI. For example, CGI fills in many of Grace Sloan Memorial Hospital’s iconic spaces. That view over the elevated walkway overlooking the bustling lobby where our doctors often carry on tense, passive-aggressive exchanges? That’s all CGI. And so are many random hallways and windows looking out onto the outside world. It’s hard to remember that Sloan Memorial isn’t even a real hospital. 
 Grey’s Anatomy may have wrapped long ago but fans are still captivated by the show’s interpersonal conflicts and heart-stopping emergencies. Today, Collider goes behind the scenes of the hit series to show how the creative team made all that medical drama come to life, guts and all.  Check it out!
